name: City University of Hong Kong (Dongguan)
native: 香港城市大学（东莞）
hook: New HK-owned campus in Dongguan's manufacturing belt; offers an MSc in Biomedical Engineering and flags AI/data science and BME as strategic areas — a low-cost venue for hands-on BCI hardware workshops.

name: Dongguan Houjie Hospital — Brain-Computer Interface Research Institute
native: 东莞市厚街医院脑机接口研究院
hook: Hospital-based BCI institute opened Jul 2025 with SCUT's Wu Kai team and a Guangzhou startup (Jixin Zhiyuan), targeting Alzheimer's, stroke and Parkinson's — an early example of Dongguan buying into BCI clinically.

name: Dongguan University of Technology — School of Life Health Technology
native: 东莞理工学院生命健康技术学院
hook: Intelligent medical engineering teaching programme in Songshan Lake; relevant for technician/engineering talent and for cheap prototyping capacity, not for research leadership.

name: Great Bay University
native: 大湾区大学
hook: Approved by the Ministry of Education in June 2025; holds a Guangdong key lab on dynamical systems and nervous-system cross-disciplinary research.

name: Guangdong Medical University — School of Biomedical Engineering
native: 广东医科大学生物医学工程学院（未来技术学院）
hook: Medical-electronics and imaging department with a Dongguan key lab in medical electronics and imaging equipment, plus a GBA lab on AI and cardiovascular/cerebrovascular engineering — AI-for-health rather than BCI.

name: Guangdong Biomedical Engineering Society
native: 广东省生物医学工程学会
hook: Provincial BME society based at Jinan University: annual conference, science award, standards and specialist branches.

name: Guangzhou Institutes of Biomedicine and Health (GIBH), CAS
native: 中国科学院广州生物医药与健康研究院
hook: Neuro-adjacent rather than neuro-core: stem-cell, gene-editing and disease-model platforms that feed neuro-biotech pipelines.

name: Jinan University — GHM Institute of CNS Regeneration (GHMICR)
native: 暨南大学粤港澳中枢神经再生研究院
hook: The GBA's anchor for CNS regeneration and repair (spinal cord injury, optic nerve), led by Kwok-Fai So (苏国辉); strong neuro-biotech and clinical-translation profile.

name: Pazhou Laboratory (AI & Digital Economy Guangdong Laboratory)
native: 琶洲实验室（人工智能与数字经济广东省实验室·广州）
hook: Has both a brain-machine intelligence centre (non-invasive BCI, brain-controlled dual-arm robots) and a brain disease & health centre — the most product-oriented BCI lab in the region.

name: South China Normal University (SCNU) — Institute for Brain Research and Rehabilitation
native: 华南师范大学脑科学与康复医学研究院
hook: Established Dec 2015 under the national brain programme; cognitive/educational neuroscience plus a BCI device programme ('智脑协生') and a Ministry of Education key lab in brain cognition and educational science.

name: South China University of Technology (SCUT) — BCI & Brain Information Processing Center
native: 华南理工大学脑机接口与脑信息处理研究中心
hook: Led by Li Yuanqing (IEEE Fellow): non-invasive BCI, brain-controlled wheelchair/home systems, BCI + speech fusion; co-founder of the Pazhou Lab brain-machine intelligence centre.

name: City University of Hong Kong (CityU) — Department of Biomedical Engineering
native: 香港城市大学生物医学工程学系
hook: Neural engineering group (e.g. Peng Shi) plus 'AI in biomedical engineering' teaching; strong micro-device and neural-interface fabrication.

name: Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU) — Imaging & social neuroscience
native: 香港浸会大学
hook: Life Science Imaging Centre with 3T MRI, EEG and fNIRS (rare for a HK liberal-arts university) and an active social-neuroscience lab doing tDCS/TMS and digital therapeutics.

name: Hong Kong Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (HKCeND)
native: 香港神经退行性疾病中心
hook: InnoHK-funded translational centre spanning risk factors, mechanisms, targets and therapeutics — a sponsor/partner candidate for neuro-biotech content.

name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) — Brain and Mind Institute
native: 香港中文大学大脑与认知研究所
hook: HK's first institute consolidating cognitive neuroscience with linguistics, otolaryngology and paediatrics; plus the Gerald Choa Neuroscience Institute (2016) and a BME department.

name: The Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK) — Centre for Brain and Education
native: 香港教育大学脑与教育中心
hook: Brain-and-education centre (opened with an international symposium on brain and education); the natural partner for educational-neuroscience programming aimed at teachers/parents.

name: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU) — BME + RCLCN
native: 香港理工大学（生物医学工程学系 / 语言认知神经科学研究中心）
hook: Research Centre for Language, Cognition and Neuroscience (est. Jan 2019) uses EEG, fNIRS and MRI for neurolinguistics; BME department supplies the hardware/neuroengineering side.

name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
native: 香港科技大学
hook: State Key Lab of Molecular Neuroscience (neurodegeneration, regeneration, drug development) plus a neuroscience research scheme and a biomedical engineering division; the HK anchor of the Shenzhen–HK brain institute.

name: The University of Hong Kong (HKU) — State Key Lab of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
native: 香港大学脑与认知科学国家重点实验室
hook: China's Ministry of Science and Technology-approved state key lab for brain and cognitive sciences; psychology department also runs social/cognitive neuroscience and neuropsychology labs with MRI/EEG.

name: neuroHK
native: 香港神经科学网络
hook: A meta-organisation that catalogs HK neuroscience labs by discipline — including a dedicated 'Neurotechnology' category — across 7 universities. Best single entry point for a HK speaker pipeline.

name: University of Macau — Centre for Cognitive and Brain Sciences (CCBS)
native: 澳门大学认知与脑科学研究中心
hook: Offers a PhD in Brain and Cognitive Sciences and an MSc in Cognitive Neuroscience; multilingual/multicultural brain research; joint lab with GDIIST on cognition and brain-inspired intelligence.

name: AIRS — Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society
native: 深圳市人工智能与机器人研究院
hook: One of Shenzhen's ten municipal basic-research institutes; medical robotics centre (flexible/micro-nano robots, image-guided intervention) is the natural AI-for-health counterpart to the brain institutes.

name: Brain Cognition and Brain Disease Institute (BCBDI)
native: 脑认知与脑疾病研究所
hook: Implantable flexible-electrode BCI (Li Xiaojian) and wearable non-invasive BCI (Wei Pengfei); also runs a brain-cognition / brain-inspired-intelligence centre.

name: Global BCI Application Demonstration Center
native: 全球脑机接口应用示范中心
hook: Public BCI experience centre opened in Huaqiangbei in October 2026, operated by Macrotellect with the subdistrict office.

name: HKU-Shenzhen Hospital
native: 香港大学深圳医院
hook: Clinical neuroscience centre (neurology + neurosurgery) that recruits postdocs in neuromedicine; the practical place to reach Shenzhen patients for any BCI/neuromodulation study.

name: Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen (HITSZ)
native: 哈尔滨工业大学（深圳）
hook: Brand-new School of Medical Engineering whose three declared directions are intelligent perception & medical equipment, neural information & brain-inspired intelligence, and bioinformatics & intelligent pharma.

name: Institute for Brain Research Advanced Interfaces and Neurotechnologies (i-BRAIN)
native: i-BRAIN 脑机接口与神经技术研究所
hook: Implantable nanoelectronic interfaces led by Charles Lieber — the highest-profile BCI lab physically in Shenzhen; expect press sensitivity.

name: Peking University Shenzhen Graduate School
native: 北京大学深圳研究生院
hook: Institute of Brain-Inspired Intelligence plus a brain-inspired chip centre (memristors, compute-in-memory) in the School of ECE — the clearest neuromorphic-silicon group in Shenzhen.

name: Peng Cheng Laboratory (PCL)
native: 鹏城实验室
hook: National-lab compute (Pengcheng Cloud Brain) and 'Cloud Brain and Mind' model work — relevant as compute/infra sponsor rather than as a neuroscience partner.

name: Shenzhen Brain Science Infrastructure (Brain Analysis & Simulation)
native: 脑解析与脑模拟重大科技基础设施（脑设施）
hook: 50,000 m² class facility with whole-brain mapping, non-human primate and behaviour platforms — the obvious venue/lab-tour anchor for a Shenzhen delegation visit.

name: Shenzhen Brain Science Society
native: 深圳市脑科学学会
hook: Organiser of the Shenzhen Brain Expo (脑博会) and founder of its BCI & human-machine intelligence branch — the single most direct route to a Shenzhen speaker roster or booth.

name: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, CAS
native: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
hook: Parent body of BCBDI, SHIBS, the Brain Science Infrastructure and SUAT — the single most useful door into Shenzhen brain science.

name: Shenzhen Institute of Neuroscience (SION)
native: 深圳市神经科学研究院
hook: 100+ PIs; language/motor/memory mapping and cortical-function rehabilitation — a clinical-translation partner rather than a university lab.

name: Shenzhen Medical Academy of Research and Translation (SMART)
native: 深圳医学科学院
hook: Newest and best-funded neuro-biotech address in Shenzhen (Institute of Neuromodulation and Cognition); likely the strongest sponsor/partner for a NeuroAI-for-health track.

name: Shenzhen University (SZU) — Psychology & Biomedical Engineering
native: 深圳大学（心理学院 / 医学部生物医学工程学院）
hook: Only Shenzhen university with both a psychology school doing cognitive neuroscience/BCI and a BME school running a 'brain-computer intelligence and neural engineering' track; runs a BCI seminar series with its first affiliated hospital.

name: Shenzhen University of Advanced Technology (SUAT)
native: 深圳理工大学
hook: University-level home of the 'Neher brain science class', a neurobiology department and the Shenzhen brain-science industry innovation centre — the venue of the 2025 Shenzhen Brain Expo.

name: Shenzhen-Hong Kong Institute of Brain Science (SHIBS)
native: 深港脑科学创新研究院
hook: The formal Shenzhen–Hong Kong brain-science bridge (70+ teams at last public count) — natural co-organiser for a cross-border NTX programme.

name: Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech)
native: 南方科技大学
hook: Department of Medical Neuroscience plus a joint Centre for Neuroscience and Neural Engineering with the University of Queensland — the most research-intensive university lab base in Shenzhen.

name: Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) — Biomedical Engineering & Psychology
native: 中山大学（生物医学工程学院 / 心理学系）
hook: SYSU's School of Biomedical Engineering sits in Shenzhen's Guangming district and works on flexible neural recording, neuromodulation and BCI devices; SYSU also hosts a psychology department.

name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen (CUHK-SZ)
native: 香港中文大学（深圳）
hook: School of Medicine with neurosurgery leadership and a recurring brain-science / brain-technology summit; strongest Shenzhen bridge to CUHK's Hong Kong neuroscience base.

name: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School (SIGS)
native: 清华大学深圳国际研究生院
hook: Biomedical engineering and health-engineering institutes with device/imaging work; useful for engineering talent, less for pure neuroscience.

name: Guangdong Institute of Intelligence Science and Technology (GDIIST)
native: 广东省智能科学与技术研究院
hook: The region's neuromorphic flagship: LYRA-β Max brain-inspired chips, a 100-billion-neuron brain-inspired heterogeneous supercomputer, and a 'dream BCI' device; five directions include BCI & neuromodulation and general brain-inspired computing systems.

name: Shenzhen People's Hospital — Brain-Computer Interface & Neuromodulation Centre
native: 深圳市人民医院 — 脑机接口及神经调控综合诊疗中心
hook: Opened October 2025 as the first public-hospital BCI and neuromodulation centre in Shenzhen, combining invasive/non-invasive BCI with stimulation-based treatment for stroke, epilepsy, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, insomnia and depression — the clearest clinical doorway in the city for device trials and patient-facing pilots.

name: Shenzhen Rehand Medical Technology (Rehand)
native: 深圳睿瀚医疗科技有限公司
hook: Builds brain-controlled rehabilitation robots: EEG-driven hand and upper-limb training devices for stroke recovery, sold as clinical rehab systems — an industry partner for any project that needs a robot on the motor end of a BCI loop.

name: MileBot Robotics (Shenzhen Maibu Robotics)
native: 深圳市迈步机器人科技有限公司
hook: Rehabilitation and mobility exoskeletons using flexible actuators — the actuation half of neurobotics, pairing naturally with a BCI or gait-intent decoder for closed-loop walking rehab.

name: SIAT — Center for Intelligent Bionics
native: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院 — 智能仿生研究中心
hook: SIAT's bionics centre works on intelligent rehab robotics for limb function reconstruction, including a bionic upper-limb assist system for motor impairment — the research counterpart to Shenzhen's rehab-robot industry.

name: Guangzhou Brain Hospital (Guangzhou Medical University)
native: 广州医科大学附属脑科医院（广州市惠爱医院）
hook: China's first psychiatric hospital (1898), Grade-3A, whose physiotherapy department runs high-volume rTMS alongside MECT — a large clinical base for non-invasive neuromodulation. Listed but not site-verified: the hospital's website returns 403 to automated reads.

name: Shenzhen Kangning Hospital (Shenzhen Mental Health Centre)
native: 深圳市康宁医院（深圳市精神卫生中心）
hook: Shenzhen's Grade-3A psychiatric hospital and municipal mental-health centre (Luohu and Pingshan campuses); its rehabilitation physiotherapy unit runs accelerated rTMS. Listed but not site-verified: the website is a JS shell that cannot be read.
